props.doc: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.
props.name: focusableWhenDisabled

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

button.Button.summary: A button component that can be used to trigger actions.

select.Arrow.summary: Displays an element positioned against the select popup anchor.

select.Backdrop.summary: An overlay displayed beneath the select popup.

select.Group.summary: Groups related select items with the corresponding label.

select.GroupLabel.summary: An accessible label that is automatically associated with its parent group.

select.Icon.summary: An icon that indicates that the trigger button opens a select popup.

props.doc: Specifies the text label to use when the item is matched during keyboard text navigation. Defaults to the item text content if not provided.
props.name: label

props.doc: A unique value that identifies this select item.
props.name: value

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

select.Item.summary: An individual option in the select popup.

props.doc: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM when the item is not selected.
props.name: keepMounted

select.ItemIndicator.summary: Indicates whether the select item is selected.

select.ItemText.summary: A text label of the select item.

select.Label.summary: An accessible label that is automatically associated with the select trigger.

select.List.summary: A container for the select items.

select.Popup.summary: A container for the select list.

select.Portal.summary: A portal element that moves the popup to a different part of the DOM.

props.doc: Whether the positioner overlaps the trigger so the selected item's text is aligned with the trigger's value text. This only applies to mouse input and is automatically disabled if there is not enough space.
props.name: alignItemWithTrigger

props.doc: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.
props.name: disableAnchorTracking

props.doc: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.
props.name: align

props.doc: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.
props.name: side

props.doc: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.
props.name: arrowPadding

props.doc: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`).`'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within the clipping boundary so it stays visible.`'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows.`'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the alignment axis to fit.`'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the preferred axis cannot fit: `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR).`'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR).`'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`. If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.
props.name: collisionAvoidance

props.doc: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.
props.name: collisionBoundary

props.doc: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.
props.name: collisionPadding

props.doc: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.
props.name: sticky

props.doc: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.
props.name: name

props.doc: Whether the select popup is initially open. To render a controlled select popup, use the `open` prop instead.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.doc: Whether the select popup is currently open.
props.name: open

props.doc: Event handler called when the select popup is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.doc: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.
props.name: highlightItemOnHover

props.doc: Provides a hint to the browser for autofill.
props.name: autoComplete

props.doc: Identifies the form that owns the hidden input. Useful when the select is rendered outside the form.
props.name: form

props.doc: Custom comparison logic used to determine if a select item value matches the current selected value. Useful when item values are objects without matching referentially. Defaults to `Object.is` comparison.
props.name: isItemEqualToValue

props.doc: When the item values are objects (`<Select.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for display in the trigger. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the label will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.
props.name: itemToStringLabel

props.doc: When the item values are objects (`<Select.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for form submission. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the value will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.
props.name: itemToStringValue

props.doc: Determines if the select enters a modal state when open. `true`: user interaction is limited to the select: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.`false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.
props.name: modal

props.doc: Whether multiple items can be selected.
props.name: multiple

props.doc: Event handler called after any animations complete when the select popup is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChangeComplete

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

props.doc: Whether the user should be unable to choose a different option from the select popup.
props.name: readOnly

props.doc: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.
props.name: required

props.doc: A ref to access the hidden input element.
props.name: inputRef

select.Root.summary: Groups all parts of the select.

props.doc: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM while the select popup is not scrollable.
props.name: keepMounted

select.ScrollDownArrow.summary: An element that scrolls the select popup down when hovered. Does not render when using touch input.

props.doc: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM while the select popup is not scrollable.
props.name: keepMounted

select.ScrollUpArrow.summary: An element that scrolls the select popup up when hovered. Does not render when using touch input.

select.Separator.summary: A visual separator between items or groups.

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

select.Trigger.summary: A button that opens the select popup.

props.doc: The placeholder value to display when no value is selected. This is overridden by `children` if specified, or by a null item's label in `items`.
